name: grace
label: 柔和绿
description: 圆角标题块和虚线三级标题，层次更柔和，适合观点和方法类文章。
source: 改写自 doocs/md 的 grace 主题（packages/shared/src/configs/theme-css/grace.css，作者 @brzhang，WTFPL），叠加在 default 主题之上。阴影已去掉，CSS 变量已展开为固定值。

vars.font: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, 'PingFang SC', Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, 'Times New Roman', serif

styles.container: font-family: {font}; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: {text}; text-align: left; word-wrap: break-word; padding: 0 4px;
styles.h1: display: table; padding: 0.5em 1em; border-bottom: 2px solid {primary}; margin: 2em auto 1em; color: {text}; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center;
styles.h2: display: table; padding: 0.3em 1em; margin: 3em auto 1.5em; color: #ffffff; background: {primary}; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center;
styles.h3: padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid {primary}; border-bottom: 1px dashed {primary}; margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: {text}; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.6;
styles.blockquote: padding: 1em 1em 1em 1.5em; border-left: 4px solid {primary}; border-radius: 6px; color: #666666; background: {quote_bg}; margin: 0 0 1em 0; font-style: italic;
styles.code_inline: font-size: 90%; color: {primary}; background: #eef7f4; padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: {mono};
styles.pre: font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 10px 8px; background: {code_bg}; border: 1px solid {border}; padding: 0;
styles.pre_code: display: block; padding: 0.8em 1em; color: #333333; font-family: {mono}; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; overflow-x: auto;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #d9e8e3; padding: 0.3em 0.6em; color: {text}; background: #eef7f4; font-weight: bold; word-break: keep-all;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #d9e8e3; padding: 0.3em 0.6em; color: {text}; word-break: keep-all;
styles.img: display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0.1em auto 0.5em; border-radius: 8px;
styles.hr: border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; height: 0; margin: 2em 0;
styles.refs_item: margin: 0.3em 8px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: {muted}; word-break: break-all;
